# Series of Calls

Synthetic communications configuration training, currently an incomplete foundation preview.
Calling, messaging, queues, workforce, rooms and information boundaries are simulated locally.
Four small exercises use fictional AU, US, JP and EU boundary settings. These are not jurisdiction approvals.
The optional physical-network game derives from Series of Tubes by Frederic Jung, under the MIT licence.
All interactions and traces are synthetic. No vendor credentials or live carriers are used.

Version: __VERSION__ (__BUILD_DATE__)
Intended publication URL: https://zanefounty.github.io/series-of-calls/
